# Third-party: hades-rustflags-guard (slot 209)

No new dependencies and no copied code. build.rs, build_guard.rs and the tests
use std only. Cargo.lock unchanged. Facts about curve25519-dalek 4.1.3
(BSD-3-Clause, https://github.com/dalek-cryptography/curve25519-dalek) were read
from its published build.rs / Cargo.toml in the local cargo registry; nothing copied.
